description:
Status of a video task started with video_create: "pending", "in_progress", "completed" or "failed". Same as GET /v1/videos/{id}.

While the video is being made, usage.estimated_cost is the amount held on the balance. Once it is "completed", usage.cost is the final price and the answer carries a link to the video file as an MCP resource (video/mp4) — read that resource to get the video itself. The file is kept for 72 hours. Files over 25 MB are not served as a resource; download those over HTTP (GET /v1/videos/{id}/content) with the same key.

Free to call: it only reads the task. Poll every 15–30 seconds, not more often.
name: video_get

created.description: When the task was started, Unix seconds.

error.description: Why the generation failed, when status is "failed".

status.description: "pending" and "in_progress" — keep polling; "completed" — the video is ready; "failed" — the hold is returned.

unsigned_urls.description: HTTP download links for the finished video; they need the same Bearer key. The MCP resource link in the answer needs nothing extra.

usage.description: Money: the hold while in progress, the final price once completed.

cost.description: Final price in kopecks, once completed.

estimated_cost.description: Amount held on the balance while the video is being made, in kopecks.

title: Check a video generation
